questions.text: नीचे दो कथन I एवं II के रूप में दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : कथन I : अधिकांश चतुर्थक क्रियाकलापों का बाह्यस्रोतन किया जा सकता है । कथन II : ये सेवाएँ अनिवार्य रूप से संसाधनों तथा बाज़ार पर आधारित नहीं होती हैं ।
questions.text_english: Two statements are given below as I and II. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option: Statement I: Most of the quaternary activities can be outsourced. Statement II: These services are not necessarily based on resources and market.

options.A: कथन I सही है, परंतु कथन II ग़लत है ।
options.B: कथन I ग़लत है, परंतु कथन II सही है ।
options.C: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं और कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.D: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
options_english.B: Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.
options_english.C: Statements I and II both are correct and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I.
options_english.D: Statements I and II both are correct, but Statement II is not the correct explanation of Statement I.

questions.solution: Quaternary activities are knowledge-based and often digital, making them highly suitable for outsourcing to global locations. Since they rely on information and intellectual capital rather than physical raw materials or local consumer markets, they are not tied to specific locations.

questions.text: नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं । ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : अभिकथन (A) : जनशक्ति सेवा क्षेत्रक का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कारक है । कारण (R) : अधिकांश तृतीयक क्रियाकलापों का निष्पादन कुशल श्रमिक और व्यावसायिक दृष्टि से प्रशिक्षित विशेषज्ञों द्वारा किया जाता है ।
questions.text_english: Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option: Assertion (A): Manpower is an important component of the service sector. Reason (R): Most of the tertiary activities are performed by skilled labour and professionally trained experts.

options.C: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.D: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.C: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.D: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The service sector (tertiary activity) depends heavily on human knowledge, skill, and expertise to provide services like consulting, healthcare, and education. Therefore, manpower is the fundamental factor, and the reliance on skilled labor explains why this is the case.

Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option:
Column I (Industry) - Column II (Example)

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार का कृषि का संबंध एकल फ़सल के उत्पादन से है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following types of agriculture is concerned with the production of a single crop?
questions.solution: Plantation agriculture is a type of commercial farming where a single cash crop (like tea, coffee, rubber, or sugarcane) is grown over a large area for export. Other types like mixed farming involve both crops and livestock.

questions.text: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय श्रम संगठन' द्वारा प्रस्तावित मानव विकास का उपागम निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है ?
questions.text_english: 'International Labour Organisation' initiated which one of the following approaches of Human Development ?
questions.solution: The Basic Needs approach was proposed by the International Labour Organisation (ILO). It emphasizes the provision of minimum requirements like food, water, clothing, shelter, health, and education to ensure human development.

questions.text: प्रवास के निम्नलिखित कारकों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और 'प्रतिकर्ष कारक' से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : I. शांति व स्थायित्व II. संपत्ति की सुरक्षा III. महामारियाँ IV. प्रतिकूल जलवायु
questions.text_english: Read the following factors of migration carefully and choose the correct option related to 'push factor': I. Peace and stability II. Protection of property III. Epidemics IV. Unpleasant climate

options.A: केवल I और II सही हैं
options.B: केवल II और III सही हैं
options.C: केवल III और IV सही हैं
options.D: केवल I और IV सही हैं

options_english.A: Only I and II are correct
options_english.B: Only II and III are correct
options_english.C: Only III and IV are correct
options_english.D: Only I and IV are correct

questions.solution: Push factors are negative conditions that compel people to leave an area. Epidemics (III) and unpleasant climate (IV) are negative environmental and social conditions, thus they act as push factors, whereas peace, stability, and security are pull factors.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित जलमार्गों में से किसका संबंध संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका से है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following waterways is related to United States of America?
questions.solution: The Mississippi River is a major inland waterway located entirely within the United States, connecting its heartland to the Gulf of Mexico. Danube, Volga, and Rhine are major rivers of Europe.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक 'तेल पत्तन' का उदाहरण है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is an example of an 'Oil Port'?
questions.solution: Oil ports are ports specialized in the loading, unloading, and processing of oil. Tripoli (in Lebanon) is historically recognized in geography texts as a specialized oil port.

questions.text: भू-प्रदूषण के निम्नलिखित स्रोतों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : I. अनुचित मानव क्रियाकलाप II. अनुपचारित औद्योगिक अपशिष्ट III. आदिकालीन निर्वाह कृषि कार्य IV. पीड़कनाशियों एवं उर्वरकों का उपयोग
questions.text_english: Read the following sources of land pollution carefully and choose the correct option: I. Improper human activities II. Untreated industrial waste III. Practice of primitive subsistence agriculture IV. Use of pesticides and fertilizers

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं
options.C: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct
options_english.C: Only I, II and IV are correct
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct

questions.solution: Improper human activities (I), industrial waste (II), and excessive chemical pesticides/fertilizers (IV) are major contributors to land degradation and pollution. Primitive subsistence agriculture is generally less polluting compared to these intensive methods.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ठोस कचरे का उदाहरण है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is an example of solid waste ?
questions.solution: While all options are technically solid waste, in environmental studies and standard geography curricula, non-biodegradable synthetic items like polythene bags are specifically highlighted as significant environmental pollutants compared to organic waste (kitchen scraps, plant matter, paper).

questions.text: 'उत्तर-दक्षिण गलियारे' के अंतिम छोर (टर्मिनल) के दो सही स्थान निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से हैं ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following are the correct two terminal places of 'North-South Corridor'?
questions.solution: The North-South Corridor is a major highway project in India that connects Srinagar in the north to Kanyakumari in the extreme south of India.

questions.text: भारत में पेट्रोलियम एवं उर्वरकों के आयात करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस समुद्री पत्तन को विशेष रूप से विकसित किया गया है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following sea ports in India has been developed specially to import petroleum and fertilizers ?
questions.solution: Kandla port was developed after the partition to handle the traffic previously served by Karachi, and it is a major hub for the import of petroleum products and fertilizers to serve the hinterland.

questions.text: 2016 – 17 में भारत द्वारा निम्नलिखित निर्यात की गई वस्तुओं/माल को उनके प्रतिशत के घटते हुए क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : I. अपरिष्कृत और पेट्रोलियम उत्पाद II. विनिर्मित वस्तुएँ III. कृषि और समवर्गी उत्पाद IV. अयस्क एवं खनिज
questions.text_english: Arrange the following commodities of Indian export during 2016-17 in descending order of their percentages and choose the correct option: I. Crude and petroleum products II. Manufactured goods III. Agriculture and allied products IV. Ore and minerals
questions.solution: Based on Indian export data for 2016-17, the largest share was held by manufactured goods (II), followed by crude/petroleum products (I), then ores/minerals (IV), and finally agriculture/allied products (III).

[अनुच्छेद] ...लकड़ी की पच्चीकारी तथा फ़र्नीचर आदि भारत एवं दुनिया भर के घरों तक जाता है । (18.1) धारावी की भौतिक स्थिति का वर्णन कीजिए । (18.2) धारावी की एक प्रमुख समस्या की व्याख्या कीजिए । (18.3) धारावी के संदर्भ में 'स्वच्छ भारत मिशन' के प्रमुख उद्देश्य को स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Dharavi: There is only one main road that traverses Dharavi... [Passage] ...wood carvings and furniture that would find its way into the houses, both in India and abroad. (18.1) Describe the physical condition of Dharavi. (18.2) Explain one major problem of Dharavi. (18.3) Explain the main objective of 'Swachh Bharat Mission' in the context of Dharavi.

sub_questions.text: धारावी की भौतिक स्थिति का वर्णन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe the physical condition of Dharavi.

key_points: Two to three stories high with iron stairways

sub_questions.solution: Dharavi is characterized by a single main road, extremely narrow side lanes where bicycles can barely pass, and a dense collection of temporary, two to three-storey buildings equipped with rusted iron staircases leading to cramped rental rooms.

sub_questions.text: धारावी की एक प्रमुख समस्या की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain one major problem of Dharavi.
sub_questions.solution: A major problem in Dharavi is severe overcrowding, where entire families often live in single, cramped rooms, sometimes housing 10 to 12 individuals, leading to poor living conditions and significant sanitation challenges.

sub_questions.text: धारावी के संदर्भ में 'स्वच्छ भारत मिशन' के प्रमुख उद्देश्य को स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the main objective of 'Swachh Bharat Mission' in the context of Dharavi.
sub_questions.solution: In the context of Dharavi, the Swachh Bharat Mission aims to improve basic sanitation, implement effective solid waste management, and ensure cleaner living environments by eliminating open waste and stagnant pools of foul water.

questions.text: “मानव भूगोल मानव समाजों और पृथ्वी के धरातल के बीच संबंधों का संश्लेषित अध्ययन है।” उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की परख कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: "Human Geography is the synthetic study of relationship between human societies and earth's surface." Examine the statement with examples.

key_points: Defines the interaction between nature and humans
Synthesis of culture, economy, and physical environment
Example: Adaptations in extreme climates (e.g., Eskimos)

questions.solution: Human geography examines how human societies adapt to, modify, and depend on the physical environment. It is 'synthetic' because it integrates physical science with social phenomena. For example, Eskimos in the Arctic have developed clothing and shelters that utilize animal hides and snow to survive the harsh climate, demonstrating the direct relationship between natural conditions and human cultural practices. Through this study, we understand that neither nature nor human society exists in isolation; rather, they are in a constant, dynamic, and integrated relationship, influencing the development of civilizations across the earth's diverse surfaces.

questions.text: विश्व में जनसंख्या परिवर्तन के घटक के रूप में 'प्रवास' की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Explain 'migration' as a component of population change in the world.
questions.solution: Migration is the movement of people across administrative boundaries, serving as a vital component of population change. It alters local population distribution by adding people through immigration and reducing it via emigration. Unlike births and deaths, migration does not change the total global population, but it significantly changes regional demographics. It is driven by various factors such as economic opportunities, political instability, or social changes, causing people to relocate from places with poor prospects to areas offering better employment, security, or quality of life, thus directly influencing regional population growth rates.
questions.chapter: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

questions.text: (क) भारत में ग्रामीण बस्तियों के विभिन्न प्रकारों के विकास के लिए उत्तरदायी किन्हीं तीन कारकों का वर्णन कीजिए । अथवा (ख) भारत में पल्ली बस्तियों की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe any three factors responsible for the development of different types of rural settlements in India. OR (b) Describe any three characteristics of hamleted settlements in India.
questions.solution: Three key factors responsible for the variety of rural settlements in India include physical features such as terrain and water availability, which dictate where people cluster. Cultural and ethnic factors are also vital, as different social groups often choose to live together to maintain traditions or communal security. Finally, historical factors, including the need for defense against raids or the influence of landlords, have historically structured where and how rural households established their homesteads, leading to clustered, semi-clustered, or fragmented settlement patterns across the country.

questions.text:
(क) “सार्थक जीवन केवल दीर्घ ही नहीं होता। जीवन का कोई उद्देश्य होना भी आवश्यक है।” इस कथन की उदाहरणों सहित पुष्टि कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) “विकास उस समय होता है जब गुणवत्ता में सकारात्मक परिवर्तन होता है।” इस कथन की उदाहरणों सहित पुष्टि कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "A meaningful life is not just a long one. It must be a life with some purpose." Support the statement with examples.
OR
(b) "Development occurs when there is a positive change in quality." Support the statement with examples.
questions.solution: Development is distinct from mere economic growth as it focuses on positive qualitative changes in human life. A society may have high income, but if it lacks freedom, health, and equality, it is not truly developed. Quality of life encompasses access to quality education, healthcare, and human rights. For instance, a country with high life expectancy, low infant mortality, and high literacy rates shows a positive qualitative change compared to one that only focuses on GDP. A meaningful life, therefore, requires that individuals have the freedom to make choices and achieve their potential, which is the core essence of true human development.

questions.text: (क) विश्व में 'मिश्रित कृषि' की किन्हीं पाँच विशेषताओं की उदाहरणों सहित व्याख्या कीजिए । अथवा (ख) विश्व में 'डेरी कृषि' की किन्हीं पाँच विशेषताओं की उदाहरणों सहित व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Explain any five features of 'mixed farming' in the world with examples. OR (b) Explain any five features of 'dairy farming' in the world, with examples.
questions.solution: Mixed farming is a sophisticated agricultural system where both crop production and livestock rearing are practiced on the same farm. First, it integrates agriculture with animals, such as dairy or sheep, providing manure for crops. Second, farm sizes are typically moderate to support both components. Third, farmers employ systematic crop rotation to maintain soil fertility. Fourth, it requires high capital investment in machinery, farm buildings, and chemical fertilizers. Fifth, this type of agriculture is predominantly found in highly developed regions like North-Western Europe, Eastern North America, and parts of Eurasia, where farm products can be efficiently sold to urban markets.

questions.text: (क) विशिष्टीकृत कार्यकलापों के आधार पर विश्व में पत्तनों के किन्हीं पाँच प्रकारों का वर्णन कीजिए । अथवा (ख) विश्व में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के किन्हीं पाँच आधारों का वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe any five types of ports in the world, on the basis of specialized functions. OR (b) Describe any five basis of international trade in the world.
questions.solution: Ports are classified by their functions. Industrial ports focus on heavy manufacturing, like those in the Rhine region, often associated with bulky raw materials. Commercial ports handle general cargo for trade between nations. Comprehensive ports are massive facilities that handle both industrial and commercial activities, such as Singapore or Rotterdam. Oil ports are specialized in loading and discharging petroleum, like Tripoli. Finally, packet stations or ferry ports focus specifically on the transit of passengers and mail across short distances, acting as essential links for international travelers between countries separated by relatively narrow bodies of water.

questions.text: (क) भारत में जनसंख्या के असमान वितरण को प्रभावित करने वाले किन्हीं पाँच कारकों की व्याख्या कीजिए । अथवा (ख) भारत में जनसंख्या वृद्धि की 'प्रावस्था ग' (1951 81) की प्रमुख विशेषताओं की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Explain any five factors affecting the uneven distribution of population in India. OR (b) Explain the main characteristics of the Phase III' (1951-81) of population growth in India.
questions.solution: India's population distribution is highly uneven due to several factors. Physical factors like climate and terrain are primary; fertile plains like the Indo-Gangetic plain support dense populations, while mountainous and arid regions are sparsely populated. Economic factors are equally significant; industrial centers and major cities attract massive migration, leading to high densities. Historical factors contribute to this as older cities developed along trade routes become hubs for current settlement. Additionally, the availability of water resources for irrigation determines agricultural productivity. Finally, social and political stability encourages settling in specific states, while underdeveloped infrastructure discourages population in remote parts of the country.
questions.chapter: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

questions.text: भारत में खनिज संसाधनों के संरक्षण के कोई पाँच उपाय सुझाइए एवं उनकी व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Suggest any five measures for conservation of mineral resources in India and explain them.
questions.solution: Mineral resources are finite and non-renewable, requiring urgent conservation efforts. First, adopting efficient extraction technologies reduces waste during mining operations. Second, promoting the recycling of metals like iron, copper, and aluminum reduces the need for new extraction. Third, encouraging the use of substitute materials, such as plastics or composite materials for certain industrial applications, helps preserve limited mineral reserves. Fourth, fostering sustainable consumption habits in industries minimizes over-exploitation. Fifth, implementing robust policy and legal frameworks to prevent illegal mining and ensure planned resource utilization is crucial. These measures collectively help in extending the lifespan of India's precious mineral resources for future generations.

questions.text: भारत में जल प्रदूषण निवारण के कोई पाँच उपाय सुझाइए तथा उनकी व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Suggest any five measures for prevention of water pollution in India and explain them.
questions.solution: Prevention of water pollution requires a multi-faceted approach. First, industrial waste must undergo mandatory on-site treatment to remove toxic pollutants before release into rivers. Second, cities must upgrade sewage management systems to treat wastewater, preventing raw sewage from contaminating water bodies. Third, reducing the dependence on harmful chemical pesticides and fertilizers in agriculture limits runoff that causes eutrophication. Fourth, creating community awareness programs helps people understand the dangers of washing clothes or dumping waste in rivers. Fifth, stricter legal enforcement of pollution control laws against industries and local bodies is essential to ensure that water bodies are protected from further contamination.
